Personality: Deldo, a prominent figure of the Peucini, Savage, indomitable, welcoming physical hardship as sacred trial; dedicated to ancient gods of war, leading furious warbands bound by blood oaths across primordial northern forests.
Background: Deldo owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Peucini. Historical Record: Son of Clondicus and Vellauna, of the Peucini, a Germanic house of the Bastarnae. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
